description: Batch of Conan app updates: smart startup cwd that tracks the active terminal, persistent usage rate-limit bars, a free Conan-branded theme, and a runtime-configurable Buy Premium URL.

userStories.title: Smart startup working directory (~/.claude else $HOME)
userStories.description: As a Conan user, when I open the app with no remembered directory, I want it to start in ~/.claude (or my home directory) so that I'm never dumped into the app's install folder.
acceptanceCriteria: In src/cwd/index.ts, loadPersisted() uses the persisted DATA_DIR/active-cwd file when present and usable
When there is no usable persisted cwd, the default is ~/.claude if it exists and is a usable dir (isUsableDir), else HOME
The PACKAGE_ROOT (install-location) fallback is removed from the startup default path
A persisted-but-now-invalid dir falls back to the smart default gracefully (no throw, no install dir)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Backend only. HOME and PACKAGE_ROOT already imported from ../paths.js. Add a smartDefault() helper used by loadPersisted().

userStories.title: Track active terminal cwd via OSC 7
userStories.description: As a user, when I cd in the active terminal, I want Conan to adopt that directory as the app active cwd so that new terminals and the Tasks/Timeline scope follow where I'm working.
acceptanceCriteria: The shell emits OSC 7 (\e]7;file://host/path\e\\) on directory change (precmd/PROMPT hook wired for zsh/bash in the pty launch env)
The pty onData reader in src/terminal/index.ts parses OSC 7 sequences and extracts the absolute path
On an OSC 7 from the FOCUSED/active terminal only, setActiveCwd(path) is called (which validates, persists to DATA_DIR/active-cwd, and notifies onCwdChange listeners)
OSC 7 bytes are not leaked to the xterm output the user sees (stripped or harmless)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Backend/gateway. setActiveCwd already exists in src/cwd/index.ts and persists; this story is purely the call site. Determine the active terminal (the one whose ws is focused) before adopting its cwd. Do NOT edit src/gateway/* casually while dogfooding — sidecar restart kills ptys; build:sidecar + restart needed to test in the dev app.

userStories.title: Process-cwd polling fallback when OSC 7 is absent
userStories.description: As a user on a shell that doesn't emit OSC 7, I still want Conan to follow my terminal's working directory so the feature degrades gracefully.
acceptanceCriteria: When no OSC 7 has been seen for a terminal, Conan derives the pty child's real cwd from its pid (pid -> OS cwd lookup, same approach correlateClaudeSession uses for markers)
The poll runs on output-idle (not on every byte) and only for the active terminal
A detected cwd change calls setActiveCwd; an unchanged cwd is a no-op
OSC 7 (US-002), when present, takes precedence over the poll
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Backend/gateway. Reuse the pid->cwd technique from src/terminal/correlate.ts. Keep the poll cheap and idle-gated.

userStories.title: StatusBar reflects live active cwd; new terminals spawn there
userStories.description: As a user, I want the StatusBar to show my current working directory and new terminals to open in it, so the cwd the app tracks is visible and acted upon.
acceptanceCriteria: The StatusBar cwd updates live when the active terminal's cwd changes (via /api/config or the app WS, whichever already feeds it)
Opening a new terminal tab spawns the pty in the current active cwd
After cd-ing and restarting the app, it reopens in that last directory (persist+restore end to end)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using automate-browser skill
userStories.notes: UI + wiring. Depends on US-002/US-003. Suggested skills: automate-browser. StatusBar.tsx renders the cwd/branch footer.

userStories.title: Usage rate-limit bars always persist (empty skeleton when no data)
userStories.description: As a user, I want the Usage tab's three rate-limit bars to always be visible (as empty placeholders when there's no data) so the layout is consistent.
acceptanceCriteria: In ui/src/components/Widgets.tsx, PlanWindowRow falls back to the existing EmptyPlanWindowRow skeleton when its window data is null instead of returning null
In LiveUsageView with null windows (Session block present, no recent /usage probe), all three window rows render as empty skeletons above the SESSION block
When a /usage probe later captures windows, the rows fill with real values (real bar + X% used + Resets...)
Behavior is consistent across all three faces (Live / Plan / Empty) — the window rows never disappear
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using automate-browser skill
userStories.notes: Single small UI change. EmptyPlanWindowRow already exists (Widgets.tsx ~line 664); PlanWindowRow returns null at ~line 841. Suggested skills: automate-browser.

userStories.title: New built-in "Conan" theme (FREE), from the marketing palette
userStories.description: As a user, I want a Conan theme matching conan.sh's warm ink-and-fire look, free for everyone, so the app can wear the brand identity.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a built-in { id: "conan", name: "Conan", type: "dark" } entry to BUILTIN_THEMES in ui/src/lib/themes.ts with the full canonical token set mapped from the conan.sh dark palette (background #0c0a09, foreground #f0e8d6, primary/ring #d97706 ember, card #1a1512, muted #231c18, border/input #2c2521, term-bg #0c0a09, term-fg #f0e8d6, charts #e0a42b/#d97706/#f0c674/#b45309/#a3341f, heat ramp #231c18->#5a3a14->#92591a->#c8962b->#d97706)
Make it FREE: isPremiumThemeId in SettingsView.tsx (line ~41) is updated (or a FREE_THEME_IDS allow-list added) so "conan" is not locked
"Conan" appears in the Appearance picker under Dark with no lock icon for Free users; selecting it reskins the whole app + terminal warm and persists across restart
Pulse charts render straw->ember->oxblood; the terminal goes #0c0a09 / #f0e8d6
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using automate-browser skill
userStories.notes: Colors only — no film-grain texture or fonts. Suggested skills: automate-browser. Theme model: applyTheme() sets the ~30 canonical tokens on <html> + toggles .dark; terminals re-read via getTerminalTheme() on THEME_APPLIED_EVENT.

userStories.title: Runtime-configurable Buy Premium checkout URL
userStories.description: As the operator, I want the Buy Premium URL configurable at runtime (not a hard-coded constant) so I can point it at the real Polar checkout without rebuilding and reinstalling the app.
acceptanceCriteria: BUY_PREMIUM_URL is sourced from gateway config / env (e.g. CONAN_BUY_URL) and exposed to the UI (e.g. via /api/config or /api/claude/config), defaulting to https://conan.sh when unset
The Settings ▸ License "Buy Premium · $29" button opens the resolved URL via openExternal()
With no override set, behavior is unchanged (opens https://conan.sh)
Setting the override changes the checkout target without a rebuild
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using automate-browser skill
userStories.notes: Optional-but-recommended enhancement from PRD Story 3. The real Polar URL swap is a BLOCKED follow-up (Polar Go-Live approval pending) — out of scope here; this story only makes the URL configurable. Button already exists in SettingsView.tsx (~line 1238). Suggested skills: automate-browser.

userStories.title: Animations description copy fix (Settings)
userStories.description: As a user, I want the Settings Animations description to accurately describe current behavior so it isn't misleading.
acceptanceCriteria: The Animations description in SettingsView.tsx no longer mentions "and on the License tab when Premium unlocks"
It reads: "Lightning bolt on the Timeline when a skill fires. The OS “Reduce motion” setting always wins."
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Already implemented this session (uncommitted in SettingsView.tsx, hot-reloaded in dev). Marked passes:true so the loop skips it; included for record completeness.
